mapper.select: SELECT qb.id AS bank_id, qb.bank_name, count(ufq.id) AS favorite_question_count FROM user_favorite_question ufq INNER JOIN question_bank qb ON qb.id = ufq.bank_id AND qb.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN category_sub_module csm ON csm.id = qb.sub_module_id AND csm.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN category_module cm ON cm.id = csm.module_id AND cm.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN category_group cg ON cg.id = cm.group_id AND cg.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ufq.user_id = #{userId} AND ufq.is_deleted = 0 AND cg.group_type = #{groupType} GROUP BY qb.id, qb.bank_name ORDER BY qb.id DESC
